metadata.title: NET_Monitor
metadata.description: The module can help system administrator to maintain monitoring of network from a central point. It helps to gather data of new hosts inside a network of class C , makes remotely HTML-reports of computers , watches status of TCP connections and free space of disk C with operating system. This modules also provides the opportunity to send notifications to the chat of Telegram. There is a function which can turn on a feature of remote desktop of Commfort program.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Set-CommfortRemoteDesktop' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
